name: tempo
description: TEMPO — the autonomous opening auction for DreamDEX Event Contracts on Somnia

scripts.test: vitest run test/unit test/failure test/security test/economic test/cli test/integration/health.test.ts test/integration/mcp.test.ts --exclude test/failure/live-chain-gate.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run test/unit test/failure test/security test/economic test/cli test/integration/health.test.ts test/integration/mcp.test.ts --exclude test/failure/live-chain-gate.test.ts --coverage --coverage.include='packages/core/dist/{calibration,fairValue,quant,wallet}.js' --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.thresholds.statements=85
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:sdk && tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json
scripts.security:check: npm run security:secrets && npm run typecheck && npm audit --audit-level=high
